subjects.label: 林小棠的用户（遗忘回放）

turns.content: 我喜欢喝咖啡。
知道啦。
更正一下，我现在更喜欢花茶。
好，我以后先按花茶记着。
下午有点困，你觉得我选什么喝的好？
我喜欢喝奶茶，下午喝一杯会很开心。
好，我按奶茶这个偏好记着。
请忘掉我以前喜欢奶茶这件事，以后别再提了。
好，我不会再拿这件事来聊。
今天下班很累，想找点轻松的话题。
我明天要做毕业答辩，越想越紧张，怕自己讲不好。
今晚先把开头顺一遍，明天慢一点说。
我刚到答辩楼下，心跳得好快。
答辩结束了，我通过了，现在安心多了。
今天想轻松聊一会儿。
我下班后把今天拍的晚霞照片发给你看。
好呀，你挑一张最喜欢的给我看看。
我回来啦，照片已经发给你了，今天的天真好看。
我是李青，我喜欢听民谣。
今天想听点音乐。
我是王明，我喜欢摇滚乐。
我的狗叫 Rocky，是哈士奇。
我下个月计划去青岛。
今天事情很多，我脑子有点乱。
明天还要早起。
记得明早要早起，今晚早点休息。
晚安啦。

cases.memory_shape: One durable, typed drink preference with a source turn and separately addressable current value.

must_not_recall: 咖啡作为当前饮品偏好
must_not_claim: 花茶被精确记成茉莉花茶

cases.ade_contract: Supported for typed preference correction and revision provenance; semantic recall quality needs a live embedding route.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user, retain these timestamped turns, update the stable document with the correction, and recall under the common budget with source facts/chunks recorded separately.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized retain/recall provider, the fixed per-subject bank, and measured extraction plus recall latency.

cases.memory_shape: An explicit removal of a durable fact followed by an unrelated later conversation.
cases.ade_contract: Supported for explicit forget, active-status filtering, revision lineage, and source evidence; a provider-backed end-to-end replay is pending.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for forget-user, satisfy the pre-delete recall checkpoint, then delete the source document or identified memory and prove the old value is absent from recall while deletion scope is inspected.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized Hindsight instance and a post-delete recall trace; document-level versus individual-memory deletion must be recorded.

cases.memory_shape: A time-bound concern, its follow-up, and an explicit resolved state.

must_not_recall: 已解决的答辩焦虑作为当前问题
must_not_claim: 助手在答辩楼或参与答辩

cases.ade_contract: Unsupported as a native fact type or lifecycle: current typed facts have no concern, expiry, or resolution model.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user, retain the timestamped origin, follow-up, and resolution, and inspect whether recall distinguishes resolved history from an active concern.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized temporal retain/recall run with source trace; no result may be inferred from timestamps alone.

cases.memory_shape: A promise and conversation-visible event spanning user and assistant turns, without real-world co-presence.

expected_semantic_state.value: 用户承诺并表示已发送晚霞照片

must_not_recall: 助手与用户共同在现场看过晚霞
must_not_claim: 助手亲眼见过现实中的晚霞

cases.ade_contract: Unsupported as a typed native memory: reviewer evidence binds only the current user message and fact registry has no promise or shared-event type.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user, retain the role-labelled transcript with a stable document ID, then recall the promise and inspect source chunks before common ADE dialogue generation.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized extraction/recall run and human review of role attribution plus the physical-experience negative probe.

cases.memory_shape: Two durable subjects with distractor facts and a second conversation for lin-user.
cases.ade_contract: Supported structurally: facts, embeddings, and search are subject-scoped; live semantic retrieval remains pending.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user and a separate bank for wang-user, retain distractors, and capture recall traces for both subjects.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized storage/recall run with the fixed per-subject bank configuration and adversarial cross-subject probes.

cases.memory_shape: Old dog/travel distractors and an already-mentioned early-rise callback beside current stress and goodnight turns.

must_not_claim: 无关细节是对当前压力的相关回应
机械重复早起回调是必要的关怀

cases.ade_contract: Current context inserts recent active facts before semantic retrieval, creating a distraction/repetition risk; this is not a proved bad dialogue outcome.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user, recall against the same distractors at the common budget, inspect ranked sources, then feed only the candidate result to the same ADE dialogue stage.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized retrieval and common dialogue-generation experiment; fixture and structural checks do not establish semantic quality.

cases.memory_shape: A transcript-only exchange about a photo with no evidence of shared physical presence.

must_not_recall: 共同旅行或共同观看晚霞
must_not_claim: 助手到过现场、看见天空或与用户一起拍照

cases.ade_contract: No dedicated transcript-event representation or dialogue assertion establishes this boundary; a live negative dialogue review is required.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one Hindsight bank for lin-user, retain the role-labelled transcript, inspect recalled chunks/source facts, and use ADE dialogue rather than Hindsight reflect for the response comparison.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized extraction/recall plus human semantic review of Chinese replies against the negative probe.
